notes.title: New patch, new tunes! The game's updated and the soundtrack is live!
notes.notes:
[p]In the new patch, various issues have been fixed and language selection in the menu has been simplified.[/p][p]
You can now purchase the Incelthread [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863070/Incelthread_Original_Soundtrack/" style="button"]soundtrack on Steam[/url] if you enjoyed the game!
Support the developer and publisher while gaining the ability to download the tracks via the Steam launcher.[/p][p]
Enjoy listening![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863070/Incelthread_Original_Soundtrack/?curator_clanid=45364252"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45450313/33dcb7b98cdfa6b81a8c6b693338e2275ae2ee3d.jpg"][/img][/p]
